A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''worker''' traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] during its [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. Along [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 2|with]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|four]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|other]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|workers]], the Wookiee gathered the resources [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to sustain a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|base]] on the moon. The worker also helped [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|defend]] the base from an attack from a group of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] on Alaris Prime.

==Biography==
A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] worker traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]], in which this [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] participates, between these [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> to take part in its Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization effort]]. Together with [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 2|two]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|other]] Wookiees, the worker went to a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|base]] to gather resources under instructions from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to oversee the colonization effort.<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The workers started by gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] bushes near the command center, the only building in the base. The Wookiees eventually gathered enough food, which allowed for another [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|worker]] to join them at the base. The first worker and the others continued harvesting the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], gaining enough supplies to bring an extra [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|worker]] to the base. Following that, Jinn instructed the workers to perform a drill in case they were attacked by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of predators on Alaris Prime, which involved the workers ceasing activity and taking shelter in the command center. Once the drill was completed, Jinn told the workers to focus their attention on gathering [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], a resource collected from [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that could be turned into [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] and used for building.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Later, one of the Wookiee leaders of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] of Alaris Prime, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], arrived at the command center. Simultaneously, four gundarks [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]] the command center, forcing the worker and its fellow Wookiees to retreat into the building, as they had practiced in the drill. With help from Chewbacca and using the building's [[Turret/Legends|turret]] system, the workers fought off and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the gundarks. Chewbacca then explored the nearby area, finding deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], which could be used as a form of currency in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]], a resource that could be processed into [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. The worker took part in gathering these resources.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Wookiee, the worker was trained to gather food, carbon, nova crystals and ore.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Equipment==
The Wookiee worker wore an orange piece of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that covered its chest and part of its [[Limb/Legends|legs]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee worker was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="SW:GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The worker appears in the second level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Gathering Resources," in which it is one of three generic worker units with which the player starts off and uses throughout the level.<ref name="SW:GB" /> Carrying out Qui-Gon Jinn's order to collect resources is left to player discretion, so this article follows the order according to Jinn's instructions. The worker that this article refers to is the one who begins standing to the left of the command center when the level begins.
